params.body:
The dashboard side of gentells-pipeline#235.

- The Reports page reads a report's age from `createdAt`; the pipeline no longer sends Sanity's `_createdAt`.
- Adding a source no longer sends `_type: 'source'`; `/store/create` adds a source whatever it is sent.
- The Playwright mocks follow.

Lint at the ceiling (24), build ok, Playwright 24 of 24. Merge together with gentells-pipeline#235. In the minutes between the two deploys, the Reports page shows no age.
params.title: A report's age from createdAt; adding a source sends no _type
